description: Header file defining graphics capabilities, extensions, and limits for ANGLE graphics library, including structures for texture capabilities, extensions, and various graphics limits for OpenGL and EGL.
external_methods: void InitMinimumTextureCapsMap(const Version &, const Extensions &, TextureCapsMap *)
Caps GenerateMinimumTextureCaps(const GLenum, const Version &, const Extensions &)

classes.name: TextureCaps
classes.description: Stores capabilities related to a specific texture format, including support for texturing, filtering, attachments, sample counts, and maximum samples.

classes.name: TextureCapsMap
classes.description: Manages a collection of TextureCaps indexed by format ID, allowing insertion, retrieval, and initialization.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: Represents supported graphics extensions, including support for various texture formats, features, and capabilities.

classes.name: Limitations
classes.description: Describes limitations of the renderer, such as support for front-facing in shaders, sample alpha to coverage, and vertex attribute aliasing.

classes.name: TypePrecision
classes.description: Defines precision and range for shader data types.

classes.name: Caps
classes.description: Contains various graphics limits and capabilities for OpenGL and shader limits.

classes.name: egl::Caps
classes.description: EGL-specific capabilities, such as NPOT surface support.

classes.name: egl::DisplayExtensions
classes.description: Supported EGL extensions for display, including context robustness, surface sharing, and stream support.

classes.name: egl::ClientExtensions
classes.description: Supported client EGL extensions, including platform and context features.

methods.name: TextureCaps()
methods.description: Constructor for TextureCaps, initializes texture capability flags.

methods.name: Extensions()
methods.description: Constructor for Extensions, initializes extension support flags.

methods.name: Limitations()
methods.description: Constructor for Limitations, initializes renderer limitations.

methods.name: TypePrecision()
methods.description: Constructor for TypePrecision, initializes data type precision.

methods.name: Caps()
methods.description: Constructor for Caps, initializes graphics limits.
